description: Header file defining data structures, macros, and function prototypes for PostScript hinting algorithms in the FreeType project.

classes.name: PSH_HintRec_
classes.description: Structure representing a hint in the PostScript hinting algorithm.

classes.name: PSH_ZoneRec_
classes.description: Structure representing an interpolation zone for strong points.

classes.name: PSH_Hint_TableRec_
classes.description: Structure representing a table of hints and zones.

classes.name: PSH_PointRec_
classes.description: Structure representing a point in the glyph outline with hinting flags.

classes.name: PSH_ContourRec_
classes.description: Structure representing a contour composed of points.

classes.name: PSH_GlyphRec_
classes.description: Structure representing a glyph with points, contours, and hinting data.

methods.name: ps_hints_apply
methods.description: Function to apply hinting to a glyph outline based on hints and globals.
